context:
2026-10-27 audit: six make/*.mk modules exist; root is ~1,660 lines; default inventory check does not require 195 public targets; --verify-migration has no live caller.

OWNER DECISION 2026-11-07 (session choice dialog): supersedes the <=90 public-target criterion. Measured 266 targets on develop b10beb761f by the spec method (241 when <=90 was reaffirmed 2026-10-27); 119 are bound to CI workflows (62), agent instructions (39), scripts (16) or synced skills (2). Scope: split into make/*.mk modules, consolidate families with no lost capability (test-live-* via PLATFORM=, equivalence reports via BENCHMARK=, test-docker-*, pr-landing-*, coverage-*, comment-policy-*, duplicate-check-*), delete targets with no consumer, inline internal-only helpers (expected ~150), replace the inventory contract with the documented-target test, and add a ceiling test at the final count so the count cannot grow. Slices: (1) migrate literal Makefile-text consumers and replace the inventory contract with the documented-target and ceiling tests; (2) delete dead targets and consolidate families, migrating callers; (3) extract modules, short root Makefile; ceiling set to the final count.

2026-11-07 progress. Slice 1: PR #4008 (branch refactor/makefile-modules, worktree BenchBox.wt-makefile-modules) replaces the inventory contract: scripts/check_make_targets.py reads GNU Make's rule database (fails on any make error/warning), docs-validate runs the documented-target check (AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/ except ADRs, .claude/skills), tests/unit/scripts/test_check_make_targets.py repeats it and caps TARGET_CEILING; removed make/check_makefile_inventory.py, make/interface_summary.py, makefile-inventory-check and the CI summary; monolith-baseline/migration-proof kept as history; fixed stray timing record from .development-tree-required. Slice 2: stacked PR on refactor/makefile-consolidate (worktree BenchBox.wt-makefile-consolidate) consolidates test-live (LIVE_PLATFORM=), test-docker pattern rules, test-marker (TEST_MARKER=), tpchavoc TPCHAVOC_ENGINE=, deletes unused targets: 265 -> 218, ceiling 218. Realistic capability-preserving floor is ~180, not ~150 (agent-facing pr-landing-remote/batch/worktree families not renamed). Remaining: slice 3 (cross-surface report family via CI matrix, uat phase targets, generate/check pairs, coverage family), slice 4 (module extraction after migrating literal-text test consumers: test_standardized_test_commands, test_ci_lint_parity, test_release_infrastructure, test_pr_arm, test_agent_write_preflight, test_cli_dispatch), then set the final ceiling.

2026-11-07 progress. Merged: #4008 (inventory contract replaced by scripts/check_make_targets.py + docs-validate + ceiling test; make-4 database parser fix), #4010 (test-live/test-docker/test-marker/tpchavoc consolidation + dead targets, 264->217), #4011 (cross-surface gates via CROSS_SURFACE_BENCHMARK, 217->203). Open: #4014 (branch refactor/makefile-split-modules, worktree BenchBox.wt-makefile-split) splits the root Makefile (1516 -> 93 lines) into make/tests.mk, reports.mk, oracle.mk, quality.mk, build.mk, pr-landing.mk, uat.mk; tests read make_targets.makefile_sources(); GNU Make database identical to develop after normalizing origin comments, .PHONY order and the new files; path-based guards (release UAT evidence reuse, release candidate selection, sqlglot overlay scan, dead-exception wiring, machine-run caller, hand-back audit, project-references baseline, comment-policy fixture digest) follow the modules. Count 203, TARGET_CEILING 203. Not yet done from the recorded scope: coverage-*, comment-policy-*, duplicate-check-* and pr-landing-remote-* consolidation (~-13, to ~190); the latter needs AGENTS.md and docs/agent/remote-closeout.md edits. Filed test-pr-arm-batch-evidence-order-pollution-20261107 (pre-existing order-dependent test failure found while verifying).
description:
AUDIT 2026-10-27 (owner-adjudicated, advisor-reviewed): the acceptance and context sections supersede this description wherever they differ. Historical text below is kept for reference.

First migrate literal consumers of the Makefile contract files and Makefile text (tests/unit/test_standardized_test_commands.py remnants, tests/system/test_ci_lint_parity.py, scripts/check_release_curation.py if kept, docs). Then restructure into grouped modules under make/ with a short root Makefile. Modules that already exist: documentation.mk, help.mk, platform-tests.mk, site-inputs.mk, worktree-maintenance.mk, worktrees.mk. Add test, quality, build, reports and uat modules as needed; move cross-surface equivalence report targets to make/reports.mk; keep docker/live/UAT/data-generator targets. The site-split-50 deletions remove the docs-build, site-* and explorer targets first, so do not create docs or explorer modules for them. Consolidate duplicate test aliases (test-quick, test-fast, test-dev, test-pytest, test-verbose, test-parallel, test-parallel-fast, test-full, test-all, test-ci, test-medium, test-medium-selected, test-smoke, test-window, test-no-cloud, test-olap) into tier targets; aliases print the replacement for one release, then are removed in a follow-up.

The contract files already exist: make/check_makefile_inventory.py, make/monolith-baseline.json and make/migration-proof.json are tracked. make/inventory.json is generated and git-ignored (.gitignore:195, #2575). Replace the four contract pieces and the makefile-inventory-check target with one test: every make target named in AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/, and the skill-sync source resolves with make -n.

Measure the baseline again before starting. On origin/develop (2026-10-09) `make -pRrq : | awk -v RS= -F: '/^# Files/,/^# Finished Make data base/ {if ($1 !~ "^[#.]") {print $1}}' | sort -u | grep -E -v -e '^[^[:alnum:]]' -e '^\$@$'` lists 241 targets; make/monolith-baseline.json records 195 public targets; the Makefile has 1532 lines and the six modules 695 more.
